title: Optimal $C^{1,1}$ and Quasi-Optimal $C^2$ Monotone Interpolation with Curvature Control
summary: We study monotone Hermite interpolation on an interval, where both function values and first derivatives are prescribed at the nodes. Among all $C^{1,1}$ interpolants, we seek one with optimal curvature, measured by $\|F''\|_{L^\infty}$. In this paper, we analyze the limitations of some classical techniques, and provide an explicit optimal construction in $C^{1,1}$ given by quadratic splines by studying the optimal velocity profile.
